title: Exact-pullback and open-unit coefficient normalizations
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative unital rings, $\varphi:A\to B$ a unital ring map, and $W,T$ schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Write $D_R(S)=D(S_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ for the ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and $Q_S=(-)\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For $v:W\to T$, write $v_R^*$ for exact inverse image on these categories [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $e_{R,v}:\mathbf L v_R^*\cong v_R^*$ be its canonical exactness identification and $\lambda_{\varphi,v}:\mathbf L v_B^*Q_T\cong Q_W\mathbf L v_A^*$ the K-flat-normalized scalar/pullback comparison [lem-pur-etale-scalar-mate-projection]. Define $\lambda^{\mathrm{ex}}_{\varphi,v}:v_B^*Q_T\cong Q_Wv_A^*$ to be the composite $(e_{B,v}^{-1}Q_T)$, then $\lambda_{\varphi,v}$, then $(Q_We_{A,v})$. For an open immersion $j:W\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-open-immersion], let $j_{!,R}$ be exact extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] and use the induced unbounded derived adjunction $j_{!,R}\dashv j_R^*$ [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction] [lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality], with unit $\eta_R$. For every $M\in D_A(W)$ define $\iota_{\varphi,j,M}:j_{!,B}Q_WM\to Q_Tj_{!,A}M$ as the $B$-adjunction transpose of the composite $Q_WM\xrightarrow{Q_W(\eta_{A,M})}Q_Wj_A^*j_{!,A}M\xrightarrow{(\lambda^{\mathrm{ex}}_{\varphi,j})^{-1}_{j_{!,A}M}}j_B^*Q_Tj_{!,A}M$. These are definitions of the exact-pullback scalar comparison and the prescribed inverse open coefficient map, without any invertibility assertion about $\iota$.

def properOpenCoefficientPullbackIso
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {W T : Scheme.{u}} (v : W ⟶ T) :
    scalarExtension φ T ⋙ (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) v).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ scalarExtension φ W
